name: crofelemer
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE MYTESI is indicated for symptomatic relief of non-infectious diarrhea in adult patients with HIV/AIDS on anti-retroviral therapy. MYTESI is an anti-diarrheal indicated for the symptomatic relief of non-infectious diarrhea in adult patients with HIV/AIDS on anti-retroviral therapy. ( 1 )
pediatric: 8.4 Pediatric Use The safety and effectiveness of MYTESI have not been established in pediatric patients.
interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS 7.1 Nelfinavir, Zidovudine, and Lamivudine MYTESI administration did not have a clinically relevant interaction with nelfinavir, zidovudine, or lamivudine in a drug-drug interaction trial [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )] .
